S.FORM: alang Isawalian pahikukian ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Ci'an go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 972 buwan, 2,516 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 26% kyan ku 646 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 74% kyan ku 1,870 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 18%, Tayan 1%, Bunun 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Isawalian pahikukian hya' ga bsilung. tay 'zil na Isawalian pahikukian hya' ga rgyax. tay mkyahu' na Isawalian pahikukian hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Isawalian pahikukian hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Isawalian pahikukian hya' ga Pukpuk. tay 'llaw na Isawalian pahikukian hya' ga Taracan. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ i[s|ɕ]awalian paħikukian ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu [ʦ|ʨ]iʔan ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan **** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku **** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** tajan * βunun * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na i[s|ɕ]awalian paħikukian ħjaʔ ɣa β[s|ɕ]iluŋ taj ʔzil na i[s|ɕ]awalian paħikukian ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkjaħuʔ na i[s|ɕ]awalian paħikukian ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na i[s|ɕ]awalian paħikukian ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na i[s|ɕ]awalian paħikukian ħjaʔ ɣa pukpuk taj ʔllaw na i[s|ɕ]awalian paħikukian ħjaʔ ɣa tara[ʦ|ʨ]an reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
